part.text:
Build passes. Implementation:

- `lib/products.ts` — `getCachedProducts()` wraps `getAllProducts()` in `unstable_cache` with tag `"products"`, so catalog reads are served from cache instead of re-querying per request. Any other view using this getter shares the same tagged cache.
- `app/page.tsx:8-15` — regular HTML `<form>` with an inline Server Action (`'use server'` inside the action) that calls `revalidateTag('products', 'max')`.

The `"max"` profile is the key choice: it marks the tag stale and triggers background revalidation (stale-while-revalidate), so the action returns immediately and admins keep working with briefly-stale data while all `"products"`-tagged views become fresh shortly after — unlike `updateTag`, which would expire immediately and block the next request on recomputation.
